title: scatac-aggregation-benchmark: code and result tables for a benchmark of aggregation scales for single-cell ATAC-seq gene activity

creators.name: Chiu, Yen-Jung
creators.affiliation: Department of Biomedical Engineering, Chang Gung University, Taoyuan, Taiwan

description:
Analysis code and derived result tables for a comparison of the scales on which single cells are aggregated into cell-type-level gene-activity profiles from single-cell ATAC-seq: raw, z-scaled and log-normalized means, pooled counts per million, the mean of counts per 10,000 and a coverage-matched control, evaluated on three cancer-associated datasets, 26 non-tumor tissues of a chromatin accessibility atlas and three matched RNA-ATAC datasets.

The archive holds code and result tables only. No data files are stored; the public datasets analyzed (GEO GSE227265, GSE201336, GSE270148, GSE184462 and GSE194122; 10x Genomics pbmc_granulocyte_sorted_10k and human_brain_3k; Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.12571947) are listed with checksums in data/.
